name: Pagination / Audit Log
description: Audit Log product scenario for the Pagination component.

controls.name: page
controls.description: Controlled current page, from 1; a page past the last one shows the last page.

controls.name: defaultPage
controls.description: Uncontrolled page on mount, from 1; read once.

controls.name: total
controls.description: Number of items being paged, an integer from 0; no items still show page 1.

controls.name: pageSize
controls.description: Items per page, an integer from 1.

controls.name: siblingCount
controls.description: Page buttons on each side of the current page, an integer from 0 to 20; the bar keeps its length near either end.

controls.name: disabled
controls.description: Disables page changes and the picker button; an open picker can still be closed.

controls.name: membrane
controls.description: Membrane spacing around the navigation buttons; the picker dialog owns its own spacing.

controls.name: labels
controls.description: Names and text of the component's own controls; the nav itself takes a native aria-label or aria-labelledby.
